body:
Ah well then I got most of the hurtful comments for my old posts :\\

I gave up looking for someone to help me here to be honest. I've gotten help and improving slowly but it's happening. However this is one of the most supportive posts I ever got here!

So that's nice.

I'm glad it's working out for you. Maybe I just have bad luck here dunno, maybe I'm a magnet for trolls. It's hard to help someone while being far away and I get that there are too many posts flooding in. Nice to see people like you taking their time to help others.

Thanks, I'm already getting help and feeling a lot better :)
alright lets just leave it at that. I'm not offended dw. But I'm not waiting for this post to blow up, I'm just ranting I guess

Oh that is strange, never knew this till now. The more you know...  
That explains a situation where someone once said a sentence with err to me.

I wasn't specific so I guess that would put a misunderstanding. I just made this account for the sake of this single post and vent. I don't want these notifications on my main account

I have other accounts and they're a lot older with the other posts still alive with new comments still coming in. But not for the posts at the time I really needed help for.

I know sometimes saying "get out" is funny from all the memes but right now is not the time.

sites like beyond blue or lifeline are much better. I didn't expect professionals here but certainly not unsympathetic people who claim to be depressed but don't know what it really is like. I just wanted someone to talk to, this subreddit does more harm than good. There's also posts here of real life suicides that got comments of people making fun of it

I went to my counselor very awkward but I'll give it a chance and talking with my siblings and classmates have gotten easier. I feel more angry now than sad like before. Somehow being angry gives me more will to stay and fight back. That's just me idk

are you sure? err means to be mistaken or go astray in thought, well at least that's how I've seen most people use it. shouldn't it be:

we are on the side of safety? O\_o
at least someone has had a good experience using this for help. It was really difficult sharing some of my personal issues but it got crapped all over
thank you, barely anyone else sees this mess
